v1.reason: circular temporal null falsely supported 40/40 monotonic-drift synthetic datasets

v2_branch.reason: Later final design added explicit physical-MasterSite geographic replication, structured common offsets by physical MasterSite x block, full raw-like end-to-end validation, and a stronger synthetic recovery audit. No SMP biological outcome was opened under V2.

synthetic_recovery_audit.boundary: Synthetic audit calibrates estimator behavior only and is not a biological effect-size prior.

code_validation.note: Focused unit, document-contract and full raw-like end-to-end validation; no SMP hysteresis support/effect outcome was produced.

frozen_hypothesis: Later recovery of the same breeding SiteIDs occurs at higher leave-one-SiteID-out surrounding population states than earlier abandonment, beyond structured non-circular temporal placement on the observed physical-MasterSite abundance trajectories.
confirmatory_requirements: Provider-resolved physical MasterSite and SiteID identity gate passes.
State-only completed vacancy-spell support gate passes after structured common-offset support filtering.
Structured non-circular common-offset null upper-tail p <= 0.05.
measurement_boundary: A_e and A_c are annual transition-state proxies from censuses bracketing observed occupancy transitions; they are not exact continuous-time demographic thresholds.
mechanism_boundary: Confirmatory support establishes history-dependent spatial recovery at the measured SiteID scale, not uniquely Allee effects, conspecific attraction, public information, site fidelity, or any single mechanism.
novelty_boundary: The candidate contribution is a prospective multi-species same-site paired test of whether abandonment and later recolonization occur at different surrounding population states, requiring both taxonomic and geographic replication and structured temporal calibration. Recolonization, buffer effects, Allee-delayed recolonization theory, social information and island-biogeographic hysteresis are not claimed as new concepts.
freeze_rule: After frozen_design_head_sha, no ecological definition, support threshold, physical identity rule, zero semantics, vacancy-spell rule, transformation, hierarchy, weighting, taxonomic/geographic replication unit, common-offset grouping, null family, resample count, inferential threshold, or interpretation gate may change in response to SMP support/effect outcomes. Provider-populated identity/zero-semantics fields are allowed only through the already-defined gates. Only demonstrable implementation bugs independent of biological outcomes may be repaired with an explicit audit trail.
